summary: Second-pass regression + focused test of the new wallet-execution refactor (ExecutionRouter, WalletExecutionAdapter, Node.js Meteora DBC sidecar, per-user encrypted wallet keys). All 35 pytest tests pass, health & metrics endpoints return expected JSON, backend restarted cleanly with no import errors, Node sidecar returns clean JSON (`pool_not_found_for_mint`) for a SOL mint sanity input, Telegram bot getMe returns ok:true username=anoncoinsniper_bot, no secret leakage detected in logs or HTTP responses, and the read-only dashboard renders unchanged (dashboard-root/mode-card/trading-card present). No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: dbc_builder sidecar correctly returns structured JSON errors (success:false, error:code) rather than throwing/hanging — good pattern for subprocess IPC.
.gitignore in dbc_builder correctly excludes node_modules; node_modules is present locally (npm install ran).

Secrets manager reuses the same Fernet key for wallet private keys as for bot secrets; this is acceptable but the operational blast-radius of that key is now higher — worth documenting in ops notes (rotation requires re-connecting every admin wallet).
InvalidWalletKeyError does not echo the raw input, verified by test_wallet_keys.py.
test_credentials: N/A (Telegram-only control, no web auth). /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required for this pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend on port 8001 via supervisor. Preview URL: https://7a6c74f6-7d35-4d44-b9e4-758a2fa317d6.preview.emergentagent.com. Trading mode defaults to paper. Node sidecar path: /app/backend/app/execution/onchain/dbc_builder/build_tx.js — invoke via stdin JSON. Pytest suite at /app/backend runs in <1s with 35 tests. Do not attempt to fund a real wallet or broadcast a live tx. Wallet key encryption uses secrets_manager.set_wallet_private_key (Fernet). Scanner logs benign anoncoin_discovery_unavailable_using_mock_feed / solscan_meta_failed warnings — intentional fallback to mock feed.

verification_details.supervisor backend status: RUNNING, uvicorn reloaded cleanly, no crash loop
verification_details.secret_leak_scan: No TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / ANONCOIN_API_KEY / SOLSCAN_API_KEY literals found in backend logs; no long base58 blobs; no secrets in /api/health or /api/metrics response bodies
verification_details.frontend: dashboard-root, mode-card, trading-card render; MODE=PAPER, TRADING=ENABLED shown correctly
